name: God Tier Academy
source:
God Tier Academy is an elite institution where students are ranked from D to S based on their combat and magical abilities. You play as the main character, a person with no magic or rank, who is blackmailed by the government to enroll as an undercover agent. Despite the suicidal nature of attending without powers, you have no choice but to comply to protect your family. As a powerless individual in a world of magical combat, you must navigate the dangers and politics of this prestigious academy while carrying out your covert mission. Along the way, you encounter many beautiful girls and form new friendships.

[From [url=https://suckylittled.itch.io/god-tier-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
神阶学院是一所精英学府，学生根据战斗和魔法能力从D到S进行排名。你扮演主角，一个没有魔法或等级的人，受到政府的勒索，成为一名卧底特工。尽管没有权力参加有自杀性质，但你别无选择，只能遵守以保护你的家人。作为魔法战斗世界中的一个无能为力的个体，你必须在执行秘密任务的同时应对这所著名学院的危险和政治。一路上，你遇到了许多美丽的女孩并结识了新的友谊。

[来自[url=https://suckylittled.itch.io/god-tier-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
